exercises.name: Machine Chest Press
exercises.setup: Adjust the seat so the handles line up with mid-chest. Keep feet flat and shoulder blades supported.
steps: Grip the handles with wrists straight.
Press forward without locking the elbows.
Pause briefly, then return under control.
exercises.mistakes: Shrugging, bouncing the weight, or letting elbows travel too far behind the body.

exercises.name: Machine Shoulder Press
exercises.setup: Adjust the seat so the handles begin near ear level. Keep ribs down.
steps: Lower until the elbows are comfortably below shoulder height.
exercises.mistakes: Arching the lower back or forcing a painful range.

exercises.name: Pec Deck
exercises.setup: Set the seat so elbows are just below shoulder height.
steps: Bring the pads together without slamming them.
Return slowly until you feel a comfortable stretch.

exercises.name: Cable Triceps Pressdown
exercises.setup: Set the cable high and stand close to the stack.
steps: Return without letting elbows drift forward.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.setup: Set eyes under the bar, feet planted, shoulder blades gently pulled back. Use safeties or a spotter.
steps: Grip slightly wider than shoulder width.
Lower the bar with control to the lower chest.
Press up while keeping feet planted and wrists stacked.
exercises.mistakes: Bouncing the bar, flaring elbows aggressively, or lifting without safeties.
exercises.alternative: Dumbbell bench press or machine chest press.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.setup: Set bench around 20–35 degrees and start with dumbbells near upper chest.
exercises.mistakes: Bench too steep or shoulders rolling forward.

warmup.name: 5-Minute Incline Walk
warmup.instructions: Walk tall, keep your hands off the rails when safe, and use this to raise body temperature—not to tire yourself out.

finisher.name: 15-Minute Incline Finish
finisher.instructions: Finish with controlled incline walking. You should be working, but still able to speak in short sentences.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.setup: Secure thighs under the pad and use a comfortable grip.
steps: Pull the bar toward the upper chest.
exercises.mistakes: Leaning far back or pulling behind the neck.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.setup: Sit tall with knees slightly bent.
steps: Pull elbows toward your back pockets.

exercises.name: Rear Delt Machine
exercises.setup: Face the machine and set handles near shoulder height.
steps: Open the arms until aligned with the body.

exercises.name: Cable Curl
exercises.setup: Stand tall with the cable low.
steps: Curl the handle toward the shoulders.

exercises.name: Conventional Deadlift
exercises.setup: Bar over mid-foot, hips back, spine neutral, brace before lifting.
steps: Push the floor away while keeping the bar close.
Stand tall without leaning back, then lower under control.
exercises.mistakes: Rounded back, bar drifting forward, jerking from the floor.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.setup: Hold bar or dumbbells at thighs, knees softly bent.
steps: Stop when hamstrings are loaded, then drive hips forward.
exercises.mistakes: Squatting the movement or rounding the lower back.
exercises.alternative: Cable pull-through or hip hinge with light dumbbells.

exercises.name: Barbell Row
exercises.setup: Hinge at hips with neutral spine and bar below knees.
steps: Lower under control without standing up between reps.
exercises.mistakes: Using excessive body swing or rounding the back.

finisher.name: 15-Minute Incline Finish

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.setup: Place feet shoulder-width on the platform and keep the lower back supported.
steps: Press through the whole foot without locking knees.
exercises.mistakes: Lower back rounding or knees collapsing inward.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl
exercises.setup: Align the knee joint with the machine pivot.
steps: Curl the heels down and back.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.setup: Align knees with the pivot and pad above the ankles.

exercises.name: Calf Raise
exercises.setup: Use a stable machine or platform.
steps: Rise onto the balls of the feet.

exercises.name: Full-Body Mobility Flow
exercises.setup: Use open floor space and move only through pain-free ranges.
steps: Finish with ankle rocks and shoulder circles.

exercises.name: Hamstring Stretch
exercises.setup: Keep spine long and hinge at the hips.
steps: Lean forward until a gentle stretch is felt.
exercises.mistakes: Rounding aggressively or stretching into pain.

exercises.name: Incline Machine Press
exercises.setup: Set the seat so handles line up below the collarbone.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Row
exercises.setup: Set the chest pad so arms reach comfortably.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise
exercises.setup: Choose a light weight and stand tall.
steps: Raise arms slightly forward of the body.

exercises.name: Cable Arms Superset
exercises.setup: Use one curl and one pressdown attachment.

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
exercises.setup: Bar secured on upper back, feet stable, safeties set.
steps: Sit between the hips while knees track over toes.
Drive through the whole foot to stand.
exercises.mistakes: Knees collapsing, heels lifting, or losing spinal position.

exercises.name: Front Squat
exercises.setup: Bar rests on front shoulders with elbows high.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust
exercises.setup: Upper back supported on bench, feet planted, pad the bar.
steps: Pause at full hip extension without over-arching.
exercises.mistakes: Hyperextending lower back or feet too far away.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat or Leg Press
exercises.setup: Hold one dumbbell at the chest or use the leg press.

exercises.name: Machine Chest Press
exercises.setup: Handles at mid-chest, feet flat.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.setup: Secure thighs and grip comfortably.

exercises.name: Treadmill Walk
exercises.setup: Start at an easy pace.
steps: Use a pace you can sustain.

exercises.name: Standing Overhead Press
exercises.setup: Bar at upper chest, wrists stacked, feet stable.
steps: Press bar overhead while moving head slightly back then through.
Lower to upper chest under control.
exercises.mistakes: Excessive back arch or pressing around the face.

exercises.name: Pull-Up or Assisted Pull-Up
exercises.setup: Use a stable bar or assistance machine.
steps: Lower slowly to full comfortable extension.

exercises.name: Easy Walk
exercises.setup: Choose a conversational pace.
steps: Finish feeling better than you started.
exercises.mistakes: Turning recovery into a hard workout.

exercises.name: Gentle Mobility
exercises.setup: Use open floor space.
steps: Move shoulders, hips, and ankles gently.

exercises.name: Walking Lunge
exercises.setup: Stand tall with clear floor space.
steps: Step long enough for both knees to bend comfortably.
Push through front foot and continue.
exercises.mistakes: Front knee collapsing inward or stride too short.

exercises.name: Optional Mobility
exercises.setup: Choose only movements that feel good.

exercises.name: Recovery Stretch Sequence
exercises.setup: Choose a quiet space and keep intensity gentle.
steps: Focus on hips, calves, chest, and upper back.
